title: Jeremiah Durham
clean_html:
Jeremiah Durham

Preserved Primary Document • durhm-j2.htm

Jeremiah Durham was born in Kent Co. DE on 26 April, 1862. He was the son of Benjamin Durham and Sally Ann Hansor . In 1883 he married Lydia Munce who was born in Kent Co. on 4 October, 1865. Lydia was the daughter of Isaiah Munce and Elmira Carty . In fact, two of Jeremiah's brothers, Enoch and Clement, also married daughters of Isaiah and Elmira. The known children of Jeremiah and Lydia were : Vertie Durham (April 1884-1942) married Augustus Rogers Minnie Durham (Nov.1885-1961) married Arvil Mosley Isaiah Durham (Sept.1889-1935) married Elsie Becket (or Loatman??) Luther Durham (4 Jan.1891-10 Jan.1963) married Maude Loatman Marvel Durham (24 April 1894- 6 Oct. 1962) married Rhoda Seeney Carolyn "Carrie" Durham (Dec.1896- 3 May,1980) married #1 Samuel Loatman #2 William Parrish #3 Jerry Clark #4 Stewart Mann Addie Durham (1900-1966) married John Mosley Myrtle Durham (24 Mar 1903 - 11 May 1982) married William Bridge Natalie Durham (c. 1907 - ) married Ulysses Owens Jessie Durham (c. 1909- ) married Edward Schultz The family appears in the Kent Co., Delaware census records from 1870 - 1910. By the 1920 census, however, they were living in Hopewell Twp., Cumberland Co., N.J. Jeremiah died in Bridgeton, NJ in 1936. He is buried in Fairfield Twp., Cumberland Co., NJ. His wife, Lydia, followed him in 1945. She is buried at Forest Grove 7th Day Adventist Church near Cheswold, DE.
